core_meaning.primary_meaning: Muhit is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Encompassing, surrounding; ocean”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Muhit corresponds to the Arabic form محيط (Arabic root ح و ط (ḥ-w-ṭ); مُحِيط (Muḥīṭ)). Its core sense is muhit; encompassing, surrounding. Muhit is Arabic مُحِيط (Muḥīṭ) 'encompassing, surrounding; ocean', from the root ح و ط (ḥ-w-ṭ). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave منحيت (a different form); the correct form is مُحِيط. The source gloss 'Protector, Defender' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.
